item.title: Ahoy, DECmate II the little PDP-8 that could
item.description:
📝 You could stick two more floppy drives in it. You could even add a hard disk or a graphics card, as long as you didn't consider what more powerful system you could have gotten instead for that money. These initial models were later nicknamed the "Straight-8" and became the best selling computer model to that time, with nearly 1,500 rolling out to customers.
🔗 Read more: http://oldvcr.blogspot.com/2026/05/ahoy-decmate-ii-little-pdp-8-that-could.html
